# CMSIS-DSP subset

Version: ARM.CMSIS-DSP 1.14.2, copied from the installed Arm pack.
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.txt and original file headers.

Includes the upstream Include/PrivateInclude headers and eight source files needed
for floating-point fast real FFT. The music spectrum service uses a 1024-point
transform. Upstream source files are unmodified.

Source: https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS-DSP/tree/v1.14.2
